card.title: Put It Back Quietly
card.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your plate's back in the cupboard, ready for Sunday lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That one's got flowers. Ours were plain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take that one. The potatoes will cover the flowers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not hiding it under potatoes. I want six matching plates.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get five more before lunch. Keep the plain ones for spares; there's no need to count those today.

mechanism: A tries to return a mismatched replacement plate as normal and expands replacement rather than disclose why the original is absent.
confusable: Unlike buying new dishes openly, A must avoid explaining the restoration and suppress the revealing count.
comparison: D37-b offers five more matching plates; D37-a offers further cleaning to remove pondweed.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
